title: Benefit-led product release announcement
objective: Measure whether the release-announcement craftbook selects marquee user-facing changes and turns them into benefit-led launch copy.
prompt: In the `Release Announcement Eval` project, read `source/release-notes.md` and write `announcement.md` for HarborCRM 3.8.0. Lead with the headline benefit, cover 2-4 marquee items with before/after benefits, include a CTA and link to full release notes, and exclude internal-only changes.

setup.about: Self-contained eval project for release-announcement. Release notes source is workspace/source/release-notes.md.
setup.missionObjectives: Write benefit-led release marketing copy grounded in shipped changes, with CTA and no internal noise.

files.content:
# HarborCRM 3.8.0 release inventory

Full notes link: https://docs.harborcrm.example/releases/3.8.0
Audience: support leads and account admins.
Marquee changes:
- Saved invoice filters: finance teams can reopen the exact invoice queue they use every week instead of rebuilding filters.
- Webhook retry visibility: admins can see next retry time and failure reason in one panel.
- Duplicate merge fix: CSV imports no longer create duplicate customer merge suggestions.
Upgrade note: integrations must rename HC_WEBHOOK_SECRET to PAYMENTS_WEBHOOK_SECRET before deploy.
Internal-only: reducer file rename, lint runner upgrade, dev dependency bump.
CTA: Upgrade to 3.8.0 and review the webhook secret migration guide.
Brand voice: calm, practical, no hype.

success.summary: workspace/announcement.md is a benefit-led release announcement with marquee shipped changes, CTA, full-notes link, migration note, and no internal noise.

checks.label: avoid emoji flourishes in the requested calm, practical brand voice

checks.pattern: missed revenue|human error|Mean Time To Resolution|MTTR|guarantee(?:s|d|ing)?|higher quality dataset|strategic growth|maximum efficiency|minimal friction|prolonged downtime|frustrated support staff|essential improvements|smarter|instant access|critical data|speeds up(?: the)? auditing process|clean and accurate|for all users|seamless
checks.label: remove invented operational-impact claims not present in the release inventory

patterns.label: avoid hype not present in the source voice
